content: Password generators (Bitwarden/1Password/client-side tools): length slider, charset toggles (upper/lower/digit/symbol), exclude similar 0O1lI, crypto.getRandomValues, copy. NIST 800-63B prefers length over composition rules. Pronounceable/Markov, saved history, and strength-as-a-product are anti-features. it-tools uses a Token Generator rather than a dedicated password UI.
